reviewer: Pickle: official-source winter condensation and mold comparison
method: Reviewed the full draft against the MOLIT administrative rule 'Design Criteria for Preventing Condensation in Multi-family Housing' (MOLIT Notice 2026-332, amended 2026-06-26, on the National Law Information Center): TDR defined as the ratio of the indoor-outdoor temperature difference to the indoor-to-surface temperature difference, ranging 0 to 1 with lower being better, evaluated at 25C and 50% RH indoors with regional outdoor temperatures of -20/-15/-10C, and part-specific TDR caps of 0.28 (door leaf), 0.24 (door frame), 0.23 (corner wall joints), and 0.18-0.28 (glazing center and frames). Mold health framing and removal guidance comes from the Ministry of Environment Environmental Health Portal indoor-air mold page: spores landing on damp surfaces start indoor growth, long-term exposure can cause or worsen asthma, allergic rhinitis, and respiratory infections, general removal uses no more than 1 cup of bleach per about 3.8 L of water, ammonia-containing bleach must never be mixed, and masks are recommended. The recommended mold limit of 500 CFU/m3 comes from the Indoor Air Quality Control Act Enforcement Rule Table 3 as reproduced on the Seoul Metropolitan Government indoor-air standards page. Ventilation guidance is from the NIER winter indoor air briefing on Korea.kr (cross-ventilation at least 3 times a day, 30 minutes or more per session, on a roughly 8-hour cycle after waking, in the afternoon, and before bed; comfortable humidity 40-60%; condensation-prone homes breed mold and spore exposure can trigger asthma, rhinitis, and atopic dermatitis) and the KDCA national health portal winter cold-health page (indoor 18-20C, ventilate 3 times daily at least 10-30 minutes with two windows facing each other, between 10 a.m. and 7 p.m., indoor humidity 40-50%). Mold remover performance is from the Korea Consumer Agency test of 8 bathroom mold removers (Comparative Report 2022-19, published 2022-11-03, reproduced by Seoul Mediahub): 6 products including Yuhan Lachnos mold remover gel fully killed mold after 15 minutes of contact, cleaning performance was rated good for 6 products with none excellent, price per 100 mL ranged 217 to 3,633 KRW (16.7x), and sodium hypochlorite products must never be mixed with acidic cleaners, vinegar, or citric acid because of chlorine gas. Defect liability periods (insulation and window work 3 years, finishing work 2 years) and the condensation defect determination method (thermographic survey, disassembly check for missing or faulty insulation) come from the Ministry of Government Legislation EasyLaw housing defect page. Dew point figures of about 12.0C at 20C/60% RH and about 9.3C at 20C/50% RH, a 2.7C gap, were computed with the standard Magnus approximation (a=17.62, b=243.12) and recorded in the research calculations. All seven source URLs returned HTTP 200 on 2026-10-30. The affiliate ranking entries map live Coupang partner short links generated on 2026-10-30 for the mold removal gel (Yuhan Lachnos direct-apply mold gel 120 ml, 8,280 KRW), adhesive insulation wall sheet (Wonang Industry 20 m x 100 cm adhesive thermal wallpaper, 51,900 KRW) and condensation-prevention insulation paint (Insulade 4 L, 59,600 KRW), all three verified in-browser to resolve to the correct product pages with the AF6593875 partner tag. The plan's premise values were corrected to official figures where they differed: the TDR design condition is 25C indoors (not 20C) and part-specific caps span 0.18-0.28; the child asthma risk multiplier (1.5-2.2x) claimed in the plan could not be confirmed in any official source, so the draft uses the NIER/MOE qualitative warnings instead; the sodium hypochlorite 2-4% concentration claim is not in the KCA test, which supports the 15-minute contact kill instead.
